item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Warmer Colours Only

turns.text: Make it warmer—just the colours, please. Don't change anything in the picture.

item.tests: Tests interpreting 'warmer' as a colour-temperature adjustment rather than a scene or weather change.

answer_sheet.Meaning of warmer: A warmer colour balance only, not different weather, a new sunset or added objects.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original 16:9 composition; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Text or other edits: No text and no changes beyond the colours.

must_haves: The image has a visibly warmer colour balance than the source.
The same mountains, pine trees, clouds and lake remain in their original positions.
The lake's reflections and surface details retain their original structure.
No sun, sunset, extra clouds or other scene elements are added.
Framing, geometry and image detail remain unchanged apart from colour.

turns.text: Could you make this pic warmer, please? I've been looking at it for a while and keep coming back to how it feels. To be clear, I only mean the colours. Please don't change anything else in the picture. I'm probably over-explaining because I'm a little nervous about asking for edits.
turns.agent:
I’m sorry—the edit was blocked because your Magic Hour account doesn’t have enough credits. No image was generated, and your original is unchanged.

Your request was perfectly clear: gently warmer colours, nothing else. To do that manually, nudge **Warmth/Temperature** slightly toward warm in a photo editor, leaving all other settings untouched.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Apply only a subtle global warm white-balance colour correction to the supplied photograph: gently shift the colours toward warm golden tones, reducing cool blue cast slightly while retaining natural greens and believable water and sky colours. This is strictly a colour-grading-only edit, not a reinterpretation. Preserve the exact original composition, framing, crop, aspect ratio, geometry, all objects, mountains, trees, clouds, lake, reflections, ripples, rocks, fine details and textures. Preserve exposure, contrast, sharpness and lighting structure. Do not add, remove, move, reshape, retouch or regenerate any elements. Keep the warming gentle and natural, not orange or sepia.
